claim: Imports completed-work and invoice CSV exports
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload two in-memory CSV fixtures and assert parsed rows, amount, and suggested invoice

claim: CSV headers do not need to match the app's field names because the user can map them before import
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload completed-work and invoice CSV fixtures with unrelated header names, map their required fields, and assert the row, value, and suggested invoice import

claim: Already billed and unfinished completed-work rows are excluded from the unbilled-work list
sandbox: fresh browser context; import completed, already-billed, and unfinished work rows and assert only the completed unbilled row and its value appear

claim: A completed-work CSV row with no status column is treated as completed
sandbox: fresh browser context; import work without a status column and assert it appears in the completed attention queue

claim: Blank required cells and non-numeric amounts are rejected without replacing saved data
sandbox: fresh browser context; save valid work, attempt the verifier's blank and non-numeric row plus a blank invoice row, assert row-number errors and unchanged data, then recover with a valid file

claim: Invoice matching suggestions stay under the user's control
sandbox: fresh demo; link one suggestion, reload, then keyboard-unlink it and assert the row and full queue total return

claim: Replacing invoice data clears links to invoices that are no longer present
sandbox: fresh demo; link the first suggestion, retain it after the same invoice moves rows, then replace with an unrelated CSV and assert the stale link clears and the full queue returns

claim: Exports the attention queue as an invoice-draft checklist CSV
sandbox: fresh demo; inspect the downloaded CSV header and assert one row per queue item

claim: CSV rows and demo review actions stay on the device
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a private row, review demo work, and assert that no request leaves the app origin

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the normal landing route, wait for its service worker, disable the HTTP cache and network, reload, and assert the landing workspace

claim: The service worker stores fetched same-origin assets for offline reuse
sandbox: fresh browser context on a unique origin; fetch the shipped social-preview asset and assert its same-origin path enters the service-worker cache

claim: Real workspace data stays in IndexedDB across a reload
sandbox: fresh browser context; import one real work row, reload, and assert its description and amount remain

claim: Exports and imports a complete workspace JSON backup
sandbox: fresh demo; download the sample workspace, enter the empty real workspace, restore the file, and assert its total

claim: $19 one-time saved review tools use Sociobot checkout and license verification
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert checkout URL, mock a valid Sociobot verification response, and assert paid state

claim: A paid license saves named reviews and shows their past list totals on this device
sandbox: fresh browser context; mock a valid license, save two named demo reviews with different queue states, and assert both counts and values are visible

claim: When amount is missing, imports calculate it from hours multiplied by rate
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a completed row with 2 hours and a $75 rate, then assert its $150 queue value

claim: Imports accept real YYYY-MM-DD and M/D/YYYY calendar dates, and invoices dated before the work are not suggested
sandbox: fresh browser context; reproduce 10/1/2026 work versus 9/1/2026 invoice, assert no suggestion, accept a cross-year later invoice, then reject malformed and impossible dates without replacing data

claim: Suggestions compare normalized client and project names, and do not suggest a different project
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a client wording variation with a matching project and a same-client different-project near miss, then assert only the matching invoice is suggested

claim: Demo data uses separate browser storage and is discarded when you start for real
where: demo banner, privacy notice, README, demo contract
sandbox: fresh browser context; retain a real row, review demo data, leave demo, then assert the real row remains and demo keys are gone

claim: Demo review data is removed when the browser session ends
sandbox: review a demo row in one fresh browser context, close the context, open a second context, and assert the sample has no retained decision

claim: Clear imported data removes the current workspace
sandbox: fresh real workspace; import one row, confirm Clear imported data, reload, and assert the workspace remains empty

claim: License verification stores only the license token and its latest verification result
sandbox: fresh browser context; mock one invalid Sociobot verification, then assert localStorage contains exactly the token and verdict keys with their expected values

claim: Imports, review, and checklist exports stay free
sandbox: fresh demo without a license; review a suggestion and download the checklist while snapshots remain marked paid

claim: Saved review tools cost $19 once through Sociobot checkout; no payment form is embedded in the app
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the one-time copy, Sociobot checkout URL, and absence of payment iframes or card fields

claim: The sweep reviews exported records; it does not send invoices, track time, calculate tax, or change source files
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the stated review boundary and the absence of invoice, time, and tax actions

claim: The footer discloses that the product artwork was generated for this product
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the landing page and assert the footer artwork disclosure
